evidence: Verified on small cases by independent enumeration, cm-fc7d1f44bfb6414b. Limit stated: n^{O(s)} time for fixed s, not poly(s,n).
proved_step: L1-fixed-s: For fixed s >= 0 and N = 2^n, let Im_s be the set of truth tables of nodes of circuits with at most s fan-in-2 gates over {x_1..x_n, 0, 1} using any of the 16 binary operations. Then |Im_s| <= (s+1)(n+s+2)·16^s·(n+s+2)^{2s}, and for each prefix length k the set {f|_[k] : f in Im_s} is computable in time |Im_s|·poly(N). Proof: at step j there are at most n+2+j earlier nodes, so there are at most (n+s+2)^{2t}·16^t circuits with t <= s gates; each circuit has at most n+s+2 nodes; summing over t = 0..s gives the bound. Scope: fixed s, all n. The per-bit cost is n^{O(s)}, so this does NOT give the poly(s,n) update needed for G0003/G0004.
